text:
maya: FYI — Karen's bday next Wed (May 4). Thinking a hybrid surprise: quick in-office breakfast + remote card/care package. Who's in? :tada:
zoe: in! what time?
maya: 10:30am by the kitchen table. quick 20-min thing so remote folks can join via Zoom. also thinking gift vote: bagels / cupcakes / fruit + office plant / remote care package. please vote.
noah: plant + bagels sounds great :+1:
oliver: remote folks can chip in for the care package. i have karen's shipping addr. link to card: https://tinyurl.com/karen-card
people-ops-bot: Heads up — we can use the team budget for a $50 gift; if we go over, we'll collect. want me to create a poll?
maya: yes please post a quick poll in this thread. i'll set the event when we decide.
people-ops-bot: Poll posted: (react to vote) :one: Bagels  :two: Cupcakes  :three: Fruit + Plant  :four: Care package (remote)
zoo (typo-oops): voted :three: Fruit + Plant :seedling: (will be at 10:30)
lina: :four: if remote peeps can send money i'll cover packaging costs.
noah: voted :one: bagels — but i'm ok with plant too.
oliver: voted :four: care package. will coordinate shipping if wins.
maya: also — can remote folks record a 30s silly video? we can play it at 10:45 for the in-office group. thoughts?
zoe: love this idea. i'll make a montage clip. who wants to send 10s clips by Tue EOD?
people-ops-bot: Reminder set: Collect clips by Tue 5pm.
noah: i'll chip in $10 via the donation link (if needed).
people-ops-bot: Donation link: https://pay.example.com/redwood-karencare (suggested $10 each)
maya: thanks! final call: if majority votes :three: Fruit + Plant, we'll do office fruit + small potted plant. if :four: wins, oliver will ship a care package and we collect funds. poll closes Mon 5pm.
lina: RSVP yes for in-person.
oliver: got it. i'll wait on poll then order.
remind-bot: Event created: "Karen's Birthday Surprise" — May 4 10:30-11:00 (Kitchen + Zoom). Invite sent to attendees.
maya: perfect — thanks everyone. tiny ask: keep it on the down-low so it's a surprise :shushing_face:
zoe: :eyes: will do.

(End of thread)
